name: Tesla Spire
primary:
A copper tower with a coil that zaps nearby enemies on its own.
A copper tower of 4 blocks topped with a Tesla coil at the aim point. Material: magic copper, fades after 30 s. While the tower stands (up to 30 s), the coil zaps up to 3 nearest visible enemies within 8 blocks every 1 s:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
self_description:
A copper tower of 4 blocks topped with a Tesla coil at your feet. Material: magic copper, fades after 30 s. The tower lifts you up; every 1 s the coil zaps up to 3 enemies within 8 blocks:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Charge 35: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
